title: 日本ダービーの後に・昇り炎舞

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan run with abandon, and not to be outdone, Yaeno Muteki reveals her competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki wins the Derby as a result. She's overcome with gratitude for her two friends, since it's their passion that brought such a great run out of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But while she may have had an amazing run, she confides in me that she was beginning to lose control of herself. She's nervous about what might happen in the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest that we work on the balance of the blaze fierce and water still within her to address her concerns. Yaeno Muteki agrees, saying she was thinking the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that decided, we turn our attention to the Kikuka Sho… only to be told a few days later that both Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan will be sitting out due to their injuries.
